rows.text: A Mirror Holder was attacked by pirates. Before dying, they entrusted the Mirror of Transcendence to a passing traveling merchant, requesting that he continue to uphold the Path of Beauty. Consequently, the merchant placed the mirror at Pier Point for the entire universe to admire. This is the most widely circulated origin story of the Beauty Mirror. The mirror reflects people's most ideal selves: The elderly see their past glory, the young see their future growth, and the physically incomplete see their own wholeness... Countless visitors lined up before the mirror, paying sky-high ticket prices just to catch a glimpse of the "Beauty" within themselves. However, some believe it is merely a projection screen that automatically generates images.
